scope: All upward ordinary-road triangle centroids with at least 5cm to their own triangle XY boundary, outside the separately checked third-teaching repair collar. Ordinary roads plus the separate civil service node compared with the saved ordinary source mesh; decorative geometry from infrastructure nodes is not road pavement. Source top-triangle edges within 1cm are separately checked by candidate 3D nearest-surface distance <=1cm because a lateral quantization shift at a real step changes ray height; these are explicitly reported. New misses fail; errors above 2.5cm fail if worsened by more than 2mm. Existing errors and excluded small/edge faces are reported, not certified.
